description: R-9 Hydraulic Network Topology, Nodal Demands, and Pipe Design Options for MATLAB Modeling is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Carlos José Pantaleón Pérez, Glory Pérez (Pontificia Universidad Católica Madre y Maestra). This dataset contains the tabular input data used for graph-based modeling and optimization of the R-9 water distribution network in MATLAB. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
